title: Nocturnal Greek Village Salad
description: A twist on the classic Greek salad, inspired by the flavors of Mexico. The nocturnal ingredient adds a unique touch to this village favorite.
instructions: 1. Preheat the grill to medium heat.
2. Grill the nocturnal leaves for 2-3 minutes per side, until slightly charred.
3. Chop the grilled nocturnal leaves and set aside.
4. Cut the Greek village tomatoes in half and place on a plate.
5. Sprinkle the chopped nocturnal leaves over the tomatoes.
6. Top with salad and serve immediately.
